# TableBody

Body section of table

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: TableBody

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { TableBody } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<TableBody>
  <TableRow>
    <TableCell>Cell 1</TableCell>
    <TableCell>Cell 2</TableCell>
  </TableRow>
</TableBody>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<TableBody>
  <TableRow>
    <TableCell>Cell 1</TableCell>
```
